blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Zamboanga del Sur Gov. Divina Grace Yu expressed severe disappointment over the persistence of illegal mining operations in the province, warning municipal government and barangay officials that unauthorized mineral extractions must be halted immediately. Yu, on Friday, Sept. 25, personally inspected Dulop and Licabang villages in Dumingag town to assess reports of ongoing illegal small-scale mining activities in the area. The site visit forms part of the provincial executive’s intensified campaign to curb environmental degradation and enforce mining laws across Zamboanga del Sur.
